Mississauga: a $6 coffee every day. How much toward a down payment?

Example only, simple arithmetic:
1) One year: $6 x 365 days = $2,190.
2) Years two and three: $2,190 x 2 = $4,380 more, $6,570 so far.
3) Years four and five: another $4,380, so $10,950 in 5 years.
$10,950 is about 1.6% of a $700,000 home price ($10,950 / $700,000). This does not count interest or growth, and your own habits and savings will differ.

Want help building your own savings plan? Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.

Example only. Not mortgage, tax or legal advice.

Krishna Rander, Realtor® | PROPERTY.CA INC., Brokerage

#mississaugarealestate #downpayment #savingmoney #keyswithkrishna

Milton: ugly kitchen? Maybe buy it.
